description:
EMINENT is an Erasmus Mundus master dedicated to embedded and cyber-physical systems, delivered by a European consortium of technical universities. The programme page carries the live application dates, scholarship information and mobility structure for the next cohort.

Programme Highlights

  • Embedded-systems specialisation with real-time and hardware-software co-design
  • Industry-linked projects across the consortium's technology partners
  • Application dates announced per cohort on the official site
  • Graduates enter automotive, aerospace, telecom and semiconductor R&D

Who Should Apply

Electrical, computer and software engineering graduates with strong C/RTOS and systems fundamentals fit the curriculum.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the EMINENT website for the live call and submit through the consortium's admission form. Key deadline information: Current application dates published on the official programme page.
